answer: An AI-agent economy mitigates Sybil attacks using optical astrometry proofs. Each agent validates identity by submitting real-time tracking data of an active comet, captured through a sable light baffle at a registered dune observatory. Attackers incur severe capital costs purchasing physical telescope optics instead of running cheap emulated software. However, atmospheric turbulence can invalidate honest nodes, and wealthy adversaries can still centralize physical hardware ownership.
